techniques.evidence: src/lib/blender-mcp/scripts/create-material.ts:156 Resolves 'the active object' inside the mutating call instead of resolving once and naming the identity; an empty selection silently skips assignment rather than giving a typed refusal.
src/lib/blender-mcp/scripts/create-material.ts:163 Result names the material, never the object it was applied to (obligation 1: return what was resolved).

src/lib/blender-mcp/service.ts:105 The bridge drives arbitrary-Python execution through an unauthenticated localhost TCP listener (the addon's, not PoF's), which is the local-port trap the decision table rules out for local-machine tools.
